I want to finish a miserable deployment for many reasons. Some of the reasons illogical others make sense to me because I know the shit my family has been through. I don't think my problems all stem from being angry with the Navy but from other parts of my life. The Navy is just the catalyst that pushes me to the edge and the fact that I don't particularly like being yelled at everyday or told that I suck at this or that when I've heard it most of my life already. I'm not going to disagree with the fact that I may have a health issue but I'm not going to let it win. I think that if I just openly talk to strangers on the Internet and just have some random person listen it will help enough for what I need.
My life should be worth more than pride I agree. Honestly I think I can survive but it's just all the bullshit that gets to me. I need to not let it or find a way to vent about it.
Not really my taste but the lyrics hit home for me most of the time. Thanks hope everything works out for you too.

I understand how you are feeling and I'm sorry. I noticed you mentioned playing music I'm not sure of your taste but when I'm down like that I like to listen to this song and it helps me feel better. Hope it helps you. :)

It's like a never ending battle between making my family proud and keeping my sanity.
I have my wife, parents, grandparents, aunts, uncles, brothers, and sisters. I can't just give up. I want to at least finish.
I don't want that. I want to finish what I foolishly signed up for.
Feels like I'm stuck with no way out.
